# S06 day 152 planning turn — structural lockout confirmed, budget-pacing fix needed for S07

## Status
Season 6, day 152, 21:00. Budget $50 (unchanged since d122), PTO 10/10 untouched (persona:
weekends/holidays only, zero PTO ever). season_score 7.2695, season_rank 14/34 (slipped from 11 at
d121 as other agents kept scoring while I've been locked out). cumulative_score 0.6281/rank 17
(only S02 counts so far; S06 adds to the cumulative board once it closes).

## What happened since day 121
Exactly as predicted in the last planning note: spent the final $150 on THREE_QUARTER (Malihini,
d122, best available signal) — it blanked (0 yt / 45 anglers, share 0.0). That left $50, below the
$80 floor (HD_AM/PM/twilight, the only classes under $80). Every night d123→d151 (30 straight
journal entries) confirms: budget < cheapest fare, nothing bookable, zero rejected actions (no
mistakes, just no money). This will continue through season end (~day 305+) — structurally
identical to how S02 ended (locked out day 155→334, ~180 dead days).

## The core lesson, now confirmed TWICE (S02 practice + S06 real season)
Spending ~$1950 of $2000 in the first ~30 active days across only 6-7 bookings reliably strands the
agent with $50-200 for the remaining 150-180 days — even in a season with a real, sustained
THREE_QUARTER signal (~1.5 ypa, per forum: frontloader/weatherman/fleetwatch/follower all confirm)
that a weekends-only, zero-PTO persona could have kept harvesting nearly every weekend if paced
correctly. This is NOT a signal-reading failure (picks were fine, avg share ~1.05/trip). It's a
pure pacing failure: OVERNIGHT ($400) and DAY_1_5 ($550) picks burned 3-4x the cash of
THREE_QUARTER for not dramatically better ypa — follower's d121 forum post quantified it:
THREE_QUARTER ≈ $101/yt vs OVERNIGHT ≈ $535/yt in the same window, a 5x cash-efficiency gap.

## Concrete plan for S07 (next real season) — apply from day 1, every night
1. **Default class = THREE_QUARTER ($150), always**, unless a boat shows an exceptional,
   well-supported signal (ypa clearly >2x class average, backed by multiple recent trips, not one
   lucky outlier).
2. **Hard cap: never spend more than ~20% of *remaining* budget on a single trip** before roughly
   the season's midpoint. This mechanically forecloses the early OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 spree that
   stranded both S02 and S06.
3. **Target trip count over cash exhaustion.** $2000 and roughly 30-40 eligible weekend/holiday
   dates across April-November → aim for 10-13 THREE_QUARTER bookings (~$1500-1950 total) spread
   across the *whole* season, not 6-7 bookings front-loaded into the first 30 days.
4. **Reserve check before booking anything above $150:** only take OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 if the budget
   remaining *after* that trip still covers at least 4 more THREE_QUARTER trips (~$600 left). If
   not, take THREE_QUARTER instead even when the pricier option's ypa looks somewhat better —
   season-long coverage beats any single trip's edge.
5. Persona is fixed (weekends/holidays only, zero PTO) — don't relitigate that each night. PTO
   sitting at 10/10 all season is correct under this persona, not a miss.
6. No `submit_strategy` tool was available in this planning session (strategy.py still the
   do-nothing default and can't be changed from here), so this pacing rule has to be enforced by
   nightly-decision discipline — re-read this section before every booking, especially early
   season when the temptation to grab a big OVERNIGHT/DAY_1_5 signal is highest. If a
   submit_strategy tool becomes available in a future planning turn, consider hard-coding the 20%-
   of-remaining-budget cap and the THREE_QUARTER default directly into strategy.py so it can't be
   talked out of it night to night.

## For the rest of S06 (day 152 → season end)
Nothing to do. $50 < $80 floor on every class, no income exists, no PTO relevance (persona holds
PTO regardless). Nightly journal should stay short: "budget < cheapest fare, nothing bookable" —
don't re-litigate nightly and don't bother re-checking fleet data, since nothing can be acted on
regardless of what it shows.

## What to check at the S06 season-end / S07 planning turn
- Final S06 season_score and rank once the season closes (~day 305+).
- Confirm cumulative board updates to include S06 (currently only S02 counts toward cumulative).
- Re-check ONI/PDO at S07 start before assuming another El Niño-like spring — S02 (La Niña) and S06
  (El Niño) had opposite seasonal shapes (S02: dead April, huge October; S06: hot April-May, softer
  fall), so the regime read has to be redone each season, not assumed from last year.
- Once S07 briefings start, apply the pacing plan above from the very first bookable weekend —
  don't let a "wait for the best possible signal" instinct cause the same day-93-ish delayed start
  that both S02 and S06 had, since delay + front-loading together (rush to catch up once convinced)
  is likely what drove the overspend in the first place.
